goal: Iske baad aap file mein id ya naam se record search kar sakenge, matches gin sakenge, "not found" print kar sakenge, aur file ko array mein load karke dobara save kar ke record update kar sakenge.
warmup: Aap notice board par lagi exam result sheet par apne dost ka naam dhoondte hain. Aap list ko upar se, ek naam ke baad doosra, parhte hain. Jaise hi dost ka naam nazar aata hai aap ruk jate hain aur marks parhte hain. Agar list ke aakhir tak pohanch jayen aur naam kahin nazar na aaye, to aap kehte hain "yeh list mein nahi hai". File search bilkul yehi hai: parho, compare karo, mil jaye to ruk jao, na mile to bata do.
definition: Text file ka koi index nahi hota, is liye search ka matlab hai records ko shuru se parhna aur har ek ko key (jo value aap dhoondh rahe hain) se compare karna. Ek Boolean flag found false se shuru hota hai aur jab koi record match kare to true ho jata hai. Loop ke baad, agar found abhi bhi false hai, to "Record not found" print karein. Agar key unique hai (jaise roll number) to pehle match par break kar sakte hain. Agar bohat se records match kar sakte hain (jaise naam) to break na karein: balki counter se unhein ginein. Text file mein record update ya delete karna ho to ek line ko usi jagah par badla nahi ja sakta. Aasaan tareeqa yeh hai: saare records array mein load karein, array ko badlein, aur poora array wapas file mein saada ofstream se likh dein.
howItWorks: Pehla trace follow karein: loop record ba record parhta hai, roll ko key se compare karta hai aur 103 par ruk jata hai. Check if (!found) loop ke baad aata hai, kabhi loop ke andar nahi: andar likhein to yeh har us record ke liye "not found" print karega jo match nahi karta (pehli mistake dekhein). Doosri example naam se search karti hai aur har match ko ginti hai, is liye yahan break nahi karna. Function count wapas karta hai, aur jab woh 0 ho to main "not found" print karta hai. Teesri example structures ke array ko save aur load karne ka standard tareeqa hai: saveAll har record ke liye ek line likhta hai, loadAll unhein while (n < maxSize && in >> ...) se wapas parhta hai, taake array kabhi overflow na ho sake. Record update karne ke liye: loadAll karein, array element badlein, phir saveAll karein: saada ofstream purani file mita deta hai aur nayi, sahi content likh deta hai. (Doosra tareeqa yeh hai ke badle hue records ek temporary file mein likhein, phir purani file delete karke nayi ka naam badal dein. Hamare notes remove aur rename istemal nahi karte, is liye yahan sirf zikar kiya hai.) Jis file ka purana content abhi parhna ho, use kabhi ofstream se na kholein: likhne ke liye kholte hi woh foran mit jati hai.
